witness.property: for every (n,k) with k_min <= k <= k_max and 2k <= n <= n_max, the binomial coefficient C(n,k) has a prime factor strictly greater than k
witness.arithmetic: exact integer arithmetic only; deterministic trial-division factorization; fail-closed on any empty range

claim: FRAGMENT certificate: deterministic, exact-integer, fail-closed check that C(n,k) has a prime factor > k for every pair with 2 <= k <= 40 and 2k <= n <= 400 (6946 instances). Certifies a finite instance range of Sylvester's theorem as recorded in standing lemma L1; does NOT cover the full universal statement (covers: fragment), and L1 neither implies nor refutes the canonical lpf-bound claim.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
